hook: Hugs, pasta, floss: one toddler's bedtime negotiation
title: Bedtime negotiations, toddler style
caption:
Every parent knows this bedtime negotiation. One more hug, one more snack, one more "just one thing"... 🥲 Stalling at bedtime is really common at this age, and a calm, predictable routine with the same steps in the same order can help. Which excuse does your little one use most? Comment below 👇
